'''Darth Immern''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]<ref name="Codex" /> of [[Human/Legends|Human]] or [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] descent<ref name="Species" /> who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In a fit of frustration, Immern [[Death/Legends|executed]] the crew of his [[Darth Immern's cruiser|personal cruiser]], an action that left [[Gender/Legends|him]] stranded in [[Realspace/Legends|space]]; the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] was forced to turn to the [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]] [[MZ-12]] to help manage the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser's]] systems, and the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] successfully guided the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] to an Imperial way station.<ref name="Codex" /> Immern chose to spend a fortune<ref name="Files">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20131220|text=Additional Personnel Files}}</ref> to upgrade the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] programming so that it could serve as his personal navigation droid, although Immern died<ref name="Codex" /> in [[Space warfare/Legends|naval combat]] at the [[First Battle of Bothawui]] in [[3671 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> leaving MZ-12 without a master.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Immern was first mentioned in the Codex entry for MZ-12 in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter|''Galactic Starfighter'']], a Digital Expansion released in [[2013]] for the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
